mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT notice.notice_post_id FROM tblNoticePost notice UNION ALL SELECT qb.question_board_id FROM tblQuestionBoard qb UNION ALL SELECT rb.review_post_id FROM tblReviewBoard rb UNION ALL SELECT fb.find_board_id FROM tblFindBoard fb ) combined_boards

SELECT seq_id, boardType, title, nickname, regdate, viewCount, commentCount, likeCount FROM ( SELECT combined_boards.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY regdate DESC) AS RNUM FROM ( -- ▼▼▼ 기존 통합 쿼리 시작 ▼▼▼ -- 1. 공지사항 (tblNoticePost) SELECT notice.notice_post_id AS seq_id, '공지' AS boardType, notice.notice_header AS title, a.admin_name AS nickname, notice.notice_regdate AS regdate, notice.notice_view_count AS viewCount, 0 AS commentCount, 0 AS likeCount FROM tblNoticePost notice LEFT JOIN tblAdmin a ON notice.admin_id = a.admin_id
UNION ALL
-- 2. QnA (tblQuestionBoard) SELECT qb.question_board_id AS seq_id, 'QnA' AS boardType, qb.question_board_title AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, qb.question_board_regdate AS regdate, qb.question_board_view_count AS viewCount, qb.question_board_comment_count AS commentCount, qb.question_board_like_count AS likeCount FROM tblQuestionBoard qb LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON qb.user_id = u.user_id
UNION ALL
-- 3. 후기 게시판 (tblReviewBoard) SELECT rb.review_post_id AS seq_id, '후기' AS boardType, rb.review_board_title AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, rb.review_board_regdate AS regdate, rb.review_board_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblReviewComment WHERE review_post_id = rb.review_post_id) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblReviewLike WHERE review_post_id = rb.review_post_id) AS likeCount FROM tblReviewBoard rb LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON rb.user_id = u.user_id
UNION ALL
-- 4. 동행 찾기 게시판 (tblFindBoard) SELECT fb.find_board_id AS seq_id, '동행' AS boardType, fb.find_board_title AS title, u.nickname AS nickname, fb.find_board_regdate AS regdate, fb.find_board_view_count AS viewCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblFindComment WHERE find_board_id = fb.find_board_id) AS commentCount, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM tblFindLikes WHERE find_board_id = fb.find_board_id) AS likeCount FROM tblFindBoard fb LEFT JOIN tblUser u ON fb.user_id = u.user_id
-- ▲▲▲ 기존 통합 쿼리 끝 ▲▲▲ ) combined_boards ) WHERE RNUM BETWEEN #{startRow} AND #{endRow} ORDER BY RNUM
